title: Dui AI
tagline: AI copilot that automates crypto bills, salaries, and subscriptions with safe cross-chain execution.
description:
The AI copilot that handles your crypto bills, salaries, and subscriptions—automatically finding the best routes across chains and executing everything on time, every time.

The promise is:

> “Nothing moves without your consent — except the things you explicitly pre-approved, within limits you control.”
how_its_made:
Due AI is built on OpenClaw as an autonomous agent framework, with a strict separation between intent, policy, and execution. The full system is orchestrated via Docker Compose, which boots the agent runtime, skills, personas, solver, and a custom MCP server for crypto-specific operations like balance checks, swaps, bridging, and transaction simulation.

For the demo, we used a Telegram bot, but the interface layer is fully decoupled. Because OpenClaw supports multiple tools, users can plug in other frontends (e.g. WhatsApp or web UIs) without changing the core logic. OpenClaw converts natural language into structured PaymentIntent objects using predefined skills and personas.

On-chain, Due AI uses a non-custodial AgentVault (Move on Sui, Solidity on EVM) with strict guardrails: per-agent spending limits, time-based resets, emergency pause, and owner-only controls. The AI never controls funds directly—it can only execute transactions that satisfy on-chain policies, otherwise the user must sign.

A notable hack: we recreated Sui’s capability-based security model on EVM using active agent mappings and lazy policy resets, achieving similar safety guarantees across ecosystems. Every executed payment is automatically logged into a tax-ready ledger for compliance and reporting.
